reason: Both are risk-bearing commercial P&C insurers earning premiums and investment income, selling through independent agents and brokers. AFG is a diversified specialty insurer, with over 35 businesses in three groupings: Property and Transportation, Specialty Casualty and Specialty Financial. It covers businesses across many industries. The comp is a Florida-focused writer of commercial residential property only (condo, HOA, apartment, assisted living). It overlaps with only the property slice of AFG, in one state and one niche. That makes it adjacent, not a direct competitor.
